quarterly_data.quarter: Cadence press release: Cadence Unveils Europe's First Sovereign AI Platform for (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cadence announced the availability of a sovereign AI data center in Munich bringing together Cadence OnCloud, NVIDIA Vera and Grace CPU systems, the Cadence Reality Digital Twin Platform and the Cadence Millennium M2000 AI Supercomputer powered by NVIDIA Blackwell; Cadence calls itself the first EDA vendor to deliver a comprehensive sovereign AI platform for semiconductor, system and AI factory design in Europe. Cadence OnCloud on sovereign infrastructure (certified to ISO 27001, ISO 27017 and SOC 2 Type II) is available today to European customers; NVIDIA Vera and Grace CPU systems, M2000 and Reality instances are planned as the Munich data center expands. Users of the Cadence Reality Digital Twin Platform named in the release: Vertiv (to design its modular MegaMod HDX AI data center), HPE (for its HPE Data Center AI Mod POD) and France-based Nation Data Center; in a recent deployment the platform increased data center capacity utilization from 71% to 89% and operational availability from 90% to 98%.
